title: Grain Accounting Manual: The Money Released on a Settlement Statement
content:
The money released on a settlement statement under Grain Marketing Contracts is the gross value the statement carries less the charges drawn onto it and less the per-unit capital retain withheld on the bushels it settles, never below zero; each charge and each allowance is worked to the cent as it is formed, and the money released is rounded to the cent once when they are brought together.

**The charges.** The charges drawn onto it are the charge lines on the grain ledger that name the statement.

**The retain.** The per-unit capital retain is withheld on the bushels the statement settles at the per-unit retain the member's marketing programme carries.

**The other four figures.** The freight differential recovered is nil, the grade allowance on damage is nil, the grade allowance on foreign material is nil and no storage charge is drawn.

**Where the remainder is small.** Where the money that remains falls under the settlement minimum the member's marketing programme carries, no payment is released and the balance is carried forward onto the member's next statement.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A hypothetical statement carries a gross value of 40,000.00 on 10,000 settled bushels. Two charge lines naming that statement stand on the grain ledger, of 900.00 and 300.00. Assume for this illustration that the member's marketing programme carries a per-unit retain of 0.003 per bushel and a settlement minimum of 25.00.

| Step | Hypothetical figure, worked to the cent as it is formed |
|---|---|
| Gross value the statement carries | 40,000.00 |
| Charges drawn onto it, being the lines naming the statement | 1,200.00 |
| Freight differential recovered | nil |
| Grade allowance on damage | nil |
| Grade allowance on foreign material | nil |
| Per-unit capital retain on 10,000 bushels | 30.00 |
| Storage charge drawn | nil |
| Money released, rounded to the cent once when they are brought together | 38,770.00 |

That remainder is above the settlement minimum, so 38,770.00 is released. Were the remainder to come to 18.00 against that same minimum of 25.00, nothing would be released and the balance would be carried forward onto the member's next statement.
